name: rubber-duck
description: Spec-driven agent workflows for planning, codebase research, frontend design, implementation, review, skill evaluation, and safe shipping.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven planning, research, frontend design, review, and commit workflows.
interface.longDescription: Turn fuzzy software work into concise PRDs, codebase-informed implementation plans, evidence-backed diagnoses, polished frontend design systems, orchestrated implementation passes, structured code reviews, internal skill evaluations, and deliberate commit/push flows.
defaultPrompt: Use Rubber Duck to write a PRD for this feature.
Use Rubber Duck to plan this implementation.
Use Rubber Duck orchestrate-implementation to coordinate this approved plan.
Use Rubber Duck frontend-design to renovate this frontend while preserving product identity.
Use Rubber Duck to review my local diff.
Use Rubber Duck skill-eval to evaluate this Rubber Duck skill or agent prompt.
Use Rubber Duck setup-codex-agents to install custom agents.
